title: TC001-Sign in from login and reach the protected dashboard
description: Users can sign in with valid credentials and are taken to the main dashboard where a fleet summary is visible.
code:
import asyncio
from playwright import async_api
from playwright.async_api import expect

async def run_test():
    pw = None
    browser = None
    context = None

    try:
        # Start a Playwright session in asynchronous mode
        pw = await async_api.async_playwright().start()

        # Launch a Chromium browser in headless mode with custom arguments
        browser = await pw.chromium.launch(
            headless=True,
            args=[
                "--window-size=1280,720",         # Set the browser window size
                "--disable-dev-shm-usage",        # Avoid using /dev/shm which can cause issues in containers
                "--ipc=host",                     # Use host-level IPC for better stability
                "--single-process"                # Run the browser in a single process mode
            ],
        )

        # Create a new browser context (like an incognito window)
        context = await browser.new_context()
        context.set_default_timeout(5000)

        # Open a new page in the browser context
        page = await context.new_page()

        # Interact with the page elements to simulate user flow
        # -> Navigate to http://localhost:8081
        await page.goto("http://localhost:8081")
        
        # -> Wait for the page to settle, then navigate to /auth/login to reach the login form.
        await page.goto("http://localhost:8081/auth/login")
        
        # -> Reload the application by navigating to http://localhost:8081/ and wait for the page to load; then re-check for the login form and interactive elements.
        await page.goto("http://localhost:8081/")
        
        # --> Assertions to verify final state
        frame = context.pages[-1]
        current_url = await frame.evaluate("() => window.location.href")
        assert '/tabs/home' in current_url, "The page should have navigated to /tabs/home after login"
        assert await frame.locator("xpath=//*[contains(., 'Fleet Summary')]").nth(0).is_visible(), "The fleet dashboard should display a Fleet Summary after successful login"
        await asyncio.sleep(5)

    finally:
        if context:
            await context.close()
        if browser:
            await browser.close()
        if pw:
            await pw.stop()

asyncio.run(run_test())
